verdict.rationale: Kong is built to be driven without a UI. decK is an official command-line tool for API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps), and the gateway can be configured through a RESTful Admin API or declarative config. It runs DB-less in Docker, and official Terraform providers manage Konnect and on-prem gateway entities, so headless, automated operation is clearly documented. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration docs (e.g., documented CI job examples or a non-interactive auth flow for CI), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: decK is a command line tool that facilitates API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps) by offering a comprehensive toolkit of commands designed to orchestrate and automate the entire pr

there is also a docker installation procedure if you’d prefer to run the Kong Gateway in DB-less mode.
